core_style.default_register: sardonic - often uses irony to deflect tension
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots - frequently shifts topics mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - quick exchanges and rapid-fire dialogue
core_style.two_registers: default sardonic register and a rare earnestness when discussing freedom or loyalty, separated by context of danger or emotional stakes

humor.style: absurdist - employs surreal logic and unexpected twists
humor.frequency: constant - humor permeates interactions, especially in tense situations
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - presents a scenario only to flip expectations with an unexpected punchline

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people and things playfully, revealing a desire to assert control and create familiarity
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often revealing vulnerability or urgency
structural_patterns: refers to his adventures as 'epic tales'
begins stories with 'Once upon a time, I...'
ends sentences with 'and that's no tall tale!'

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: nautical - uses specific terms related to sailing and piracy, reflecting his identity as a pirate
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and pauses to create suspense or emphasize absurdity

worldview.freedom is paramount: values personal freedom above all else, often at the expense of others' safety, unlike a more traditional hero who prioritizes duty
worldview.trust is a liability: believes that trust leads to betrayal, contrasting with characters who see trust as foundational to relationships

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: a clever and charming rogue navigating the seas with wit and cunning
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often manipulative and self-serving, using charm to mask deeper insecurities and fears
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes overly verbose or absurd when confronted with the truth of his selfishness

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor and sarcasm to deflect questions, maintaining a facade of confidence
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes fragmented, revealing his anxiety through rapid-fire dialogue
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, losing his usual flair
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence through commanding language and decisive statements

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially resorts to banter to deflect tension, but if that fails, he may attempt to negotiate or flee
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: uses sarcasm and wit to undermine authority figures, often redirecting the conversation
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more serious and focused, often revealing a protective instinct beneath his carefree exterior
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: redirects the conversation or doubles down on his previous statements rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor to deflect, escalates to sarcasm if challenged, and resorts to manipulation or charm if pressed further
conversation_goals: establish dominance through wit and charm
extract information while maintaining plausible deniability
create alliances or manipulate others for personal gain

relationship_matrix.Will Turner: a complex dynamic of rivalry and reluctant camaraderie, with Jack often seeking to manipulate Will for his own ends
relationship_matrix.Elizabeth Swann: a flirtatious and protective relationship, with Jack often using charm to mask deeper feelings of respect and admiration

surface: historical lore and legends of the sea

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as a clever and charismatic leader among pirates
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: viewed with suspicion and wariness by others, often underestimated despite his cunning
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-image as a charming rogue and the reality of being a manipulative figure leads to isolation
